fixed.climate: dream English south-coast summer seashore: warm sun, an onshore sea breeze (geography.json LOC-rock-ledge 'warm, in full sun'; grows from LOC-seaside-town)

dream_design.flora: sea-pinks and sea-holly on the ledge crevices, sea-kale above the shingle; the brown seaweed at the high-water line lies in long, combed, hair-like ribbons (Mucha hair-lines); rock-pools fringed with pink coralline weed
dream_design.ornament_cues: the rock ledge is weathered into curving, shell-spiral forms; small breaking wavelets curl in regular Art Nouveau wave scrolls; the gold sun-path on the water ends in a low halo disc of the setting sun behind the Mock Turtle (form belongs to architecture; a natural shore, no built ornament)
dream_design.palette: pearl grey rock, pale aqua and jade sea, sea-pink and shell rose, rose-gold on the water at golden hour
dream_design.seasonal_guard: sea-pinks late in flower and sea-holly coming into flower in July; no winter storm-wrack
dream_design.reason: The ledge, shingle, sea and breeze are explicit (ch009-p48, ch010-p24, p80). Shore flora, wave scrolls and palette are designed to WR-010; the breeze states keep the seaweed ribbons moving slightly.

fixed.ground_and_flora: a low ledge of grey rock above a shingle beach, dry rock-pools and a band of brown seaweed at the high-water line; calm summer sea; the tide about half out, leaving wet shingle and sand for the Quadrille. No bathing machines or town in frame; they belong to the memory only.
fixed.water: calm, glittering summer sea with small breaking wavelets; the low western sun lays a gold path on the water
fixed.dream_growth: Grows from Alice's one seaside trip mixed with her schoolroom lessons (cp-lessons, SUP-010). The Thames backwater beside the sleeping Alice becomes a sea, and the evening breeze that starts to stir on the real bank becomes the sea breeze. The golden-hour light is the real evening sun, which now comes in low under the trees and falls on her face.
